title: Arise and Shine, Little Light
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Isaiah threw the curtains wide
And called out to the land:
"Arise and shine, your light has come!
The dawn is close at hand."

[Chorus]
Arise, arise, my little light,
The morning comes for me;
The Lord Himself will be my sun,
As bright as bright can be.

[Verse 2]
The world lay grey and heavy-still,
With shadows everywhere;
But glory rose on all His own
And sparkled in the air.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
When Scout woke up, the hall was grey,
So Scout crept to the glass
And watched the sky turn pink and said,
"It's back! The grey has passed!"

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
One day we will not need the sun
To light the sky above;
The Lord will be our endless light
And fill the world with love.

[Chorus]
mood: Waking music. A small harp rolling slow broken chords upward, like light climbing a wall at dawn, with a cello holding one warm low note underneath. Each verse starts a step higher and a little brighter than the last, and the song ends with the harp open and ringing, like curtains pulled wide on a clear morning.
